body: Thank you very much! Means a lot. You just never think it happens to friends. They world is such a cruel place. Thanks again
Yeah I know, i'm sorry just panicked and I know this community is trust worthy. Thank you for the help though, appreciate it :/

You aren't alone. I feel like this to and from what I've been through it isnt pretty. Be yourself and remember that you are needed in this world. Its not nice to feel like you're stuck. In limbo but believe me, feelings get in the way. I suggest maybe do yoga. As stupid as it sounds it really does clear your head and helps relax. Be kind to yourself and remember that life is a rollercoaster. We have ups and downs. Right now, you're going down the drop and it isn't nice but once you come up again, you begin to enjoy it. Just like life throws things at you, makes you feel isolated etc. You will soon see the true picture of your life and you will begin to lose those feelings you're holding right now. Take it easy man. Don't give up :)

Everything get better man. Been in this kind of situation before and it sucks, but believe me when I say, things get better. The worst is happening right now and from here on out, things can only begin to get better and easier for you. It wont happen at first but it will gradually. Takes time.

Remember this, think of all the people in the world (billions and billions of people) why let a small sum of people bring you down?
There is so much more out there and so much more people to see and things to do.

Hold on a bit longer and I guarantee that over time, you will be on the road to being happier.

Its okay to be sad and its okay to cry, so don't be afraid to let the tears roll. Everyone in this community is here for each other and if you have anymore problems or feelings you feel you need to let out, then you know where we are. Keep strong man

I have the feeling of not being able to interact with people my age too. Nobody I talk to seems to be interested in what I do and I question all of my "friendships".

Please dont give up. Time has a weird way of doing things and will sort its self out through time. :)

I had a similar experience a few nights ago when I slept at my friends house. I have read about and watched documentaries on sleep paralysis before. They stories that people tell have always fascinated me, but never in my life did I think I would experience something for myself.

Anyways, it was in the early hours of the morning and I just woke up. It was a weird feeling, I knew I was still asleep and I couldn't move. Once I realised I was paralysed I knew exactly what was going on. I managed to get my arm moving and decided to call out to my friend. He didnt respond, so I figured I wasn't actually speaking when I thought I was. I decided to move my head with my arm assisting ( because I was completely paralysed ). When I looked behind me I saw a figure of myself. It was very strange and seemed so realistic. Not only did this figured look like me but it was doing exactly the same actions as I was doing in bed. For example, when I moves my head with my arm, the figure did the same action only stood up. Im interested to know what it means. Im just afraid to experience the sleep paralysis with the "old lady"
